GOV-F-004-S76.title: Append-Only Enforcement and Immutability Guarantees
GOV-F-004-S76.description: Implement strict append-only behavior at the persistence layer ensuring audit records cannot be updated or deleted. Enforce write-once semantics, reject mutation operations, and validate immutability at the database access layer.
GOV-F-004-S76.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write control patterns); docs/adr/ADR-0010-safety-incident-logging.md (immutability expectations); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S77.title: Audit Logging API Endpoints
GOV-F-004-S77.description: Create backend API endpoints for audit log ingestion and controlled retrieval, including filters by trace_id, actor, and time range. Ensure endpoints enforce access control and do not allow mutation operations.
GOV-F-004-S77.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/main.py (FastAPI patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (controlled read interface); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S78.title: System Integration with Debug Logger and Tool Router
GOV-F-004-S78.description: Integrate append-only audit logging into existing system components including debug_logger, tool_router, and safety_service to ensure all GPT and Claude operations emit standardized audit events.
GOV-F-004-S78.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing logging); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (governed execution path); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/domain/shared/safety/safety_service.py (critical audit events); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S79.title: End-to-End Audit Logging Validation Tests
GOV-F-004-S79.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating that all critical operations generate audit logs, logs are immutable, retries do not duplicate inconsistently, and access control/redaction rules are enforced.
